name: CURT (Claim Span Identification in Tweets)
reason: Sundriyal et al. (EMNLP 2022) introduce CURT, 9,458 claim spans over 7,555 tweets with human BIO annotation. The paper's code repository (LCS2-IIITD/DABERTA-EMNLP-2022) ships no data: its README instructs users to supply their own train/test/validation files in an empty dataset/ folder. No Hub mirror of the labeled tweets was found; the one Hub dataset with a matching name (ariondas/claim-span-dataset) is gated and could not be inspected.
reconsider_if: The authors publish the labeled tweets (or tweet IDs plus spans) in a readable location, or the gated Hub copy is confirmed to be a faithful, accessible mirror.

reviews.findings: No usable download for the labeled data exists (empty dataset/ folder in the authors' repo; gated Hub copy).
